chunks.title: EduSync Project
chunks.text: EduSync is a Academic platform developed by Keshvi. Multi-role academic platform with AI-powered assignment generation. A comprehensive education management system developed for the Department of Computer Science at AMU and currently in departmental use. Features: Four roles: Admin, Lab In-charge, Instructor, and Student. LLM-generated weekly questions, test cases, and mixed-concept challenges. Compiler API for code execution and evaluation. Lab, session, student group, and performance dashboards. Submission review, feedback, leaderboards, dark mode, and activity logs. Technologies: React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS, LLM APIs.

chunks.title: Talk2Doc Project
chunks.text: Talk2Doc is a Mobile application developed by Keshvi. Mobile doctor consultation app. A React Native consultation app for a single doctor's practice, supporting the patient journey from registration and payment through secure chat and reporting. Features: Patient registration and payment before consultation. Secure doctor–patient chat with text, image, and file sharing. Consultation lifecycle management. Feedback management and report generation. Technologies: React Native, Expo, NativeWind, Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL.

chunks.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Large Language Models: Evolution, Architectures, Applications, and Challenges (2020–2025)
chunks.text: Keshvi published 'Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Large Language Models: Evolution, Architectures, Applications, and Challenges (2020–2025)' in Wiley · WIREs Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery on August 5, 2026. Publication type: Review paper. A PRISMA-guided review of 91 studies on RAG evolution, architectures, retrieval and reranking, faithfulness, robustness, security, governance, and open research challenges. DOI: https://doi.org/10.1002/widm.70122.

chunks.title: AI-Driven Knowledge Retrieval for Medical Question-Answering Using Large Language Models and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
chunks.text: Keshvi published 'AI-Driven Knowledge Retrieval for Medical Question-Answering Using Large Language Models and Retrieval-Augmented Generation' in IEEE · IMPACT2026 on February 14, 2026. Publication type: Comparative study. Compares prompting and RAG approaches on MedMCQA, with Answer-Expansion RAG achieving the strongest accuracy and a statistically significant improvement over traditional and prompt-only approaches.
